results: The ACTUAL original native Dirichlet H1-valued inverse has exact complex BILINEAR Green symmetry for EVERY pair of full continuous-dual inputs. At an ACTUAL algebraically simple isolated complex eigenvalue, EVERY full-native-dual contour image is a scalar multiple of the actual H1 eigenfunction. Green symmetry proves F(g)=nu*J(g)(g). Its bilinear mass J(g)(g) is proved NONZERO using the actual full algebraic range and positive conjugate mass test; nonvanishing is not supplied as a hypothesis and geometric simplicity alone is not used.

The ACTUAL full-dual-to-H1 contour projection has EXACT formula Q(F)=(F(g)/J(g)(g))*g, for ALL full continuous-dual data F. This retains the original full native domain and base; ordinary L2 data are only a faithful restriction of that full base.

The faithful inclusion of EVERY ordinary physical interval L2 datum in the FULL native dual evaluates on EVERY native test by the LITERAL integral from 0 to 1 of F(x)*g(x), with no conjugation and NO normalization factor. Physical Cauchy-Schwarz has constant EXACTLY one. The native mass is the same literal product integral of the original continuous representatives.

The entire original zero-trace H1 domain is included by a bounded complex-linear map into its IDENTICAL continuous representative on the CLOSED physical interval, in the supremum norm. The ACTUAL same contour integral therefore constructs a bounded projection-output map from ALL ordinary physical L2 data into that exact uniform-norm space; its physical L2 realization is the SAME previously verified original contour projection.

The ACTUAL L2-to-uniform contour operator is EXACTLY its rank-one kernel. At EVERY point of the CLOSED physical interval it equals (integral F*g)/(integral g*g) times the original g(x). Its actual strong operator norm is bounded by norm(g)_L2*norm(g)_uniform/abs(integral g*g), with the actual nonzero COMPLEX bilinear denominator retained.

A shared bounded-operator theorem compares normalized complex rank-one kernels between DIFFERENT input/output normed spaces. Applying it to the ACTUAL original Dirichlet contour operators proves an explicit L2-to-uniform norm comparison from their actual physical L2 eigenfunction error, uniform eigenfunction error and both actual bilinear masses. The bilinear mass difference is controlled by (norm(g)_L2+norm(h)_L2)*norm(g-h)_L2, and the corresponding functional difference has exact physical L2 constant one.

ONE open neighborhood in the ORIGINAL ambient complex H-minus-one norm and ONE cutoff work for ALL high original source circles. Their ACTUAL original physical L2 projections have the literal integral kernels, using actual zero-trace H1 eigenfunctions of EXACT unit physical L2 norm and literal norm-square integral one. Their complex bilinear square integrals are proved NONZERO, and the identical continuous outputs have the actual strong operator bound. NO contour, isolation, projection, rank or bilinear-normalization hypotheses are supplied in this source theorem.
